GET Items Database

/osrs/items

Browse and search the complete OSRS items database with pagination and filtering.

📋 Query Parameters

page number
Page number for pagination (default: 1)
max_results number
Maximum results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
where JSON string
SQL-like filtering conditions
?where={"name":"iron","members":true}

🔗 Related Endpoints

GET /osrs/items/{id} - Get specific item by ID
Example: /osrs/items/17
GET /osrs/search/items?q={query} - Search items by name
Example: /osrs/search/items?q=iron sword

📤 Example Requests

Basic List (First 5 items)

GET /osrs/items?max_results=5

Specific Item by ID

GET /osrs/items/17

Search Items

GET /osrs/search/items?q=iron

🏷️ Item Properties

  • id - Unique item identifier
  • name - Item display name
  • examine - In-game examine text
  • wiki_name - Wiki page name
  • wiki_url - Full wiki URL
  • icon_path - Icon file path
  • members - Members-only item
  • tradeable - Can be traded
  • stackable - Stacks in inventory
  • noted - Is noted version
  • noteable - Can be noted
  • equipable - Can be equipped
  • cost - Shop/NPC cost
  • lowalch - Low alchemy value
  • highalch - High alchemy value
  • weight - Item weight (kg)
  • quest_item - Quest-related item
  • release_date - Release date

⚠️ Error Responses

404 - Item Not Found

{ "error": true, "statusCode": 404, "message": "Item with ID 999999 not found" }

400 - Invalid Parameters

{ "error": true, "statusCode": 400, "message": "Invalid page number" }
